theorems_only_on_branches.name: Harappan.collapse_energy_bounded
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (classes : List SymbolicClass) (h_nonempty : classes.length > 0) (h_bounded : ∀ c ∈ classes, c.energy ≤ 1) : collapseEnergy classes ≤ 1

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Harappan.high_confidence_uniqueness
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (sys : ConsistentHypothesisSystem) : ∀ id : SignId, (sys.phonemeHypotheses.filter (fun h => h.signId == id && h.confidence.value > 0.9)).length ≤ 1

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Harappan.semantic_consistency
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (g : SemanticGraph) (h : g.consistent) : ∀ id : SignId, (g.meaningsFor id).filter (fun m => m.confidence.value > 0.8) |>.length ≤ 1

theorems_only_on_branches.name: Harappan.wf_valid_refs
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (wf : WellFormedAssignment) : wf.phonemes.all (fun h => wf.signs.get? h.signId ≠ none)
